facts.fact: Raxio DRC, a carrier-neutral data centre operated by Raxio in the DRC (general manager Yannick Sukakumu), is operating and hosting the Kinshasa Internet Exchange KINIX, which relocated there per a release of 2026-08-20.

Raxio DRC is described in the release as a Tier III certified carrier-neutral facility; the release does not name the certifying body, and the statement is made by the KINIX/Raxio release itself, dated 2026-08-20.
